payload.goal: Find MOFs that bind CO2 strongly in humid air (CO2 must out-bind water).

Round-1 exploration shows a small set of cheap-simulator leaders with strong CO2 binding and CO2 > H2O.

* The overall S_mace leader is m43d2c30, Cd, S_mace = –2.847, E_CO2_mace = –2.847 eV vs E_H2O_mace = –0.141 eV [c0002]; render shows CO2 placed near O neighbours at 2.89 Å with nearest metal 6.72 Å [c0008].

OMS Mn,Mo with S_mace –0.9 eV and E_H2O positive, suggests CO2 selectivity.
Zn OMS tier 1 with S_mace –0.423 eV, decent CO2 binding and low cost.
Zn OMS tier 1, S_mace –0.42 eV, consistent with OMS binding trend.
Cu OMS tier 1 with S_mace –0.297 eV, CO2 stronger than water in cheap model.
Zn OMS tier 1, S_mace –0.285 eV, moderate cheap score to test transfer.
U OMS with S_mace –0.44 eV, explores actinide OMS chemistry.
Li OMS tier 1, S_mace –0.438 eV, large pore and high surface area.
La OMS tier 2, S_mace –0.436 eV, tests lanthanide OMS binding.
